input.subject: Oven repair – Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay (ref R/PM025-1) – warranty contractor details
input.body:
Dear Felix,

Thank you for your reply about the oven at Flat 2, 176 Lantern Quay, Westmarsh, ZZ8 5ZZ (ref R/PM025-1). We will pursue a warranty repair at no charge as you ask.

So we can contact the right company, could you please send us the name and contact details of the contractor Keystone Works used to replace the oven last year, together with anything you have from that replacement (the oven make/model, installation or purchase date, and any invoice or warranty paperwork)?

As soon as we have these we will ask them to attend under warranty and keep you and the tenant updated. If the warranty claim is refused or a charge is proposed, we will come back to you before anything is agreed.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
